name: SettingsButton

component.name: SettingsButton
component.description: Opens the Settings panel, with Audio, Video, Share screen, and Statistics tabs, in a draggable desktop panel or a mobile bottom sheet.

props.name: className
props.description: Additional CSS class for the button.

props.name: renderContent
props.description: Custom content that replaces the default Settings icon.

props.name: onClose
props.description: Called when the panel closes, including when the mobile sheet is dismissed. On desktop, the panel closes only when you click the button again or use the panel's close button.

props.name: isMobile
props.description: Shows the panel in a mobile bottom sheet instead of the desktop panel. Not detected automatically. The sheet closes when you swipe it down, tap outside it, or use its close button.

props.name: panelClassName
props.description: Additional CSS class for the settings panel, on desktop and mobile.

props.name: panelStyle
props.description: Inline styles for the settings panel, on desktop and mobile.

props.name: anchor
props.description: Anchors the desktop panel to this element instead of the button. Pass an HTML element or any object with getBoundingClientRect(). Ignored on mobile.

props.name: panelProps
props.description: SettingsPanel options you can set here: tabs and testSoundUrl.

props.name: popoverProps
props.description: Initial position of the desktop panel: side, align, sideOffset, alignOffset, and collisionPadding. By default the panel opens above the button, aligned to its start edge, and moves to the opposite side when there isn't enough room. Ignored on mobile.

types.name: SettingsButtonPopoverProps
types.description: Initial placement of the desktop settings panel. Not exported by name; pass an object literal.

fields.name: side
fields.description: Preferred side of the button or anchor. Moves to the opposite side when there isn't enough room.

fields.name: sideOffset
fields.description: Distance from the button or anchor, in pixels.

fields.name: alignOffset
fields.description: Offset from the chosen alignment, in pixels.

fields.name: collisionPadding
fields.description: Minimum gap kept from the viewport edges, in pixels.

fields.name: isMobile
fields.description: Renders only the panel content. Supply a mobile sheet or another container to display and dismiss it.

fields.name: onClose
fields.description: Shows a close button and is called when it is pressed. Without onClose, no close button is shown.

fields.name: activeTab
fields.description: Controls the active tab. Defaults to the first visible tab.

fields.name: onTabChange
fields.description: Called when the user switches tabs.

fields.name: tabs
fields.description: Which tabs to show, in the order provided. Defaults to all tabs.

fields.name: testSoundUrl
fields.description: URL of the sound played by "Test speaker". Defaults to the SDK ring tone. The speaker test is only shown when a localAudioTrack is passed to ZoomUIToolkitProvider.

types.name: VirtualElement
types.description: Not exported by name. Pass an HTML element, or any object with a getBoundingClientRect() method that returns a DOMRect.

fields.name: getBoundingClientRect
fields.description: Returns the position and size to anchor to.

types.name: SettingsTab
types.description: Settings category. Tab labels: 'audio' is "Audio", 'video' is "Video", 'share' is "Share screen", and 'qos' is "Statistics". The share tab currently has no controls.

behavior: The button is disabled until the session is connected.
The panel opens on the Audio tab, or on the first visible tab if Audio is hidden. The selected tab is kept while the button stays mounted.
